02 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE WORK

Curiosity is
the starting point.

Isaac Gold.
Developer. Builder. Zamyilton.

I’m a Lagos-based frontend developer and Computer Science graduate. My work brings together technology, storytelling and an interest in useful digital products.

I care about how an interface feels: the flow through a form, the behavior of a conversation, the controls in a game and the small interactions between them.
